root.label: lexgine
root.desc: Top-level module map of the engine. Arrows run from a provider to its downstream consumer.

nodes.name: Interface Codegen
nodes.desc: Annotation tokens and the Python generator that emit the engine's exported DLL surface.

nodes.name: Core Foundation
nodes.desc: Global object pool, JSON settings, entity identity, diagnostics, math and utility library.

nodes.name: Task Scheduling
nodes.desc: Lock-free worker pool that executes a task DAG; the substrate every frame is built on.

nodes.name: OS Integration
nodes.desc: Win32 window, message pump and the listener chain that delivers input and resize events.

nodes.name: Shader Compilation
nodes.desc: DXC shader-model 6.x front end plus reflection that resolves binding points into root layout.

nodes.name: DXGI Layer
nodes.desc: Adapter and output enumeration, memory budgets, display modes and swap-chain presentation.

nodes.name: GPU Artifact Caches
nodes.desc: On-disk streamed caches for shader, root-signature and PSO blobs keyed by content hash.

nodes.name: D3D12 Device Layer
nodes.desc: The engine's Direct3D 12 abstraction: device, heaps, resources, descriptors, commands, sync.

nodes.name: Asset Conversion
nodes.desc: Decodes KTX/PNG/JPEG images and converts them to GPU-ready, block-compressed textures.

nodes.name: Scene Graph
nodes.desc: glTF-backed node hierarchy with meshes, materials, lights and cameras, batched into draws.

nodes.name: Debug UI
nodes.desc: ImGui overlays: a command console with autocomplete and a CPU/GPU profiling view.

nodes.name: Rendering Tasks
nodes.desc: Schedulable units that record command lists — submesh draws, UI, query flush, GPU submission.

nodes.name: Frame Orchestration
nodes.desc: Owns the frame graph, per-frame services and the swap-chain link that drives presentation.

nodes.name: Engine Bootstrap
nodes.desc: Public entry point: brings up logging, settings, device and render loop from EngineSettings.

nodes.name: Annotation Tokens
nodes.desc: LEXGINE_CPP_API and DEPENDS_ON macros that mark types and methods for export.

nodes.name: Interface Generator
nodes.desc: Python pass that scans annotated headers and emits DLL interface and IoC glue from templates.

nodes.name: IoC Object Model
nodes.desc: Runtime container the generated facades resolve through, with compile-time call detection.

nodes.name: Utility Library
nodes.desc: Flags, static containers, hashing, logging, dates and compile-time helpers used everywhere.

nodes.name: Entity & Diagnostics
nodes.desc: Typed entity identity plus the exception and error-behavioral base shared by every subsystem.

nodes.name: Linear Algebra
nodes.desc: Vector and matrix templates, boxes and rectangles, and projection/transform helpers.

nodes.name: Globals & Settings
nodes.desc: Type-keyed global object pool and the JSON-backed settings that size every engine budget.

nodes.name: Pipeline Descriptors
nodes.desc: API-agnostic state descriptions later translated to their Direct3D 12 equivalents.

nodes.name: Allocators & Blobs
nodes.desc: Allocator concept, ring-buffer and default allocators, and the owning/non-owning blob wrappers.

nodes.name: Streamed Cache
nodes.desc: Red-black-indexed, cluster-based on-disk cache with eviction; the store behind GPU blob caches.

nodes.name: Profiling Services
nodes.desc: Per-task CPU and GPU timing services that feed the profiler overlay and PIX markers.

nodes.name: Shader Preprocessor
nodes.desc: Resolves #include directives in HLSL sources before they reach the DXC front end.

nodes.name: Hash Functions
nodes.desc: Fixed-width digest type plus BLAKE3, xxHash, FNV-1a and SpookyHash implementations.

nodes.name: Hashed Strings & UUIDs
nodes.desc: Interned, hash-keyed strings used as map keys, and UUID generation for cache identity.

nodes.name: Compile-Time Utilities
nodes.desc: Type-list iteration, type naming, ordering predicates and constant conversion traits.

nodes.name: Type-Safe Flag Sets
nodes.desc: Macro-generated strongly typed bit flags that wrap the native Direct3D 12 flag enums.

nodes.name: Small Containers
nodes.desc: Fixed-capacity vector and an optional container used to return fallible results.

nodes.name: Logging & Date/Time
nodes.desc: Time-zone aware timestamps and the engine-wide log sink with severity filtering.

nodes.name: Hazard Pointer Pool
nodes.desc: Deferred reclamation scheme that makes lock-free node retirement safe under contention.

nodes.name: Lock-Free Queues
nodes.desc: MPMC queues: an unbounded linked queue and the fixed-capacity ring used by the sink.

nodes.name: Task Abstractions
nodes.desc: Task base classes with profiling hooks, including the no-concurrency variant for pinned work.

nodes.name: Task Graph
nodes.desc: Dependency DAG with barrier sync nodes, topological setup and per-frame node duplication.

nodes.name: Task Sink
nodes.desc: Worker-thread pool that dispatches graph nodes, propagates errors and drains on shutdown.

nodes.name: Event Listeners
nodes.desc: Variadic listener mix-in plus the concrete keyboard, mouse, size and paint listener contracts.

nodes.name: Win32 Window
nodes.desc: Window creation, message pump and dispatch of native messages into registered listeners.

nodes.name: Window Handler
nodes.desc: Facade handed to the application: binds a window to the swap chain and the render loop.

nodes.name: Fence Event
nodes.desc: Win32 event object the D3D12 sync layer signals and blocks on when waiting for a fence.

nodes.name: DXGI Interop
nodes.desc: Shared DXGI enums, COM interface helpers and the exported DXGI facade declarations.

nodes.name: Adapter Enumeration
nodes.desc: Enumerates adapters including WARP, reports feature level, memory budget and properties.

nodes.name: Outputs & Display Modes
nodes.desc: Per-adapter display outputs, supported display modes and desktop coordinate queries.

nodes.name: Swap Chain
nodes.desc: Flip-model swap chain: back-buffer retrieval, resize on window change and Present().

nodes.name: HLSL Types & Macros
nodes.desc: Shader model, stage and compilation-target enums plus macro definition records passed to DXC.

nodes.name: DXC Compiler Proxy
nodes.desc: Loads dxcompiler.dll dynamically and compiles HLSL to DXIL with reflection data attached.

nodes.name: Shader Function
nodes.desc: One compiled entry point with its reflected binding points, descriptor tables and counters.

nodes.name: Shader Stage Linking
nodes.desc: Groups functions into a pipeline stage and resolves shader arguments into a binding layout.

nodes.name: Shader Blob Cache
nodes.desc: Caches compiled HLSL translation units by source digest, with deferred compilation contracts.

nodes.name: Root Signature Cache
nodes.desc: Caches serialized root signatures so identical layouts are compiled once per cache lifetime.

nodes.name: PSO Blob Cache
nodes.desc: Caches graphics and compute pipeline-state blobs keyed by their full descriptor contract.

nodes.name: Debug & Validation
nodes.desc: Enables the D3D12 debug layer, GPU-based validation and PIX marker instrumentation.

nodes.name: State Converters
nodes.desc: Maps API-agnostic blend, raster, filter and format constants onto their D3D12 equivalents.

nodes.name: Device & Capabilities
nodes.desc: ID3D12Device wrapper: object creation plus a typed view over every D3D12 feature tier.

nodes.name: Resource Factory
nodes.desc: Owns the long-lived per-device pools: descriptor heaps, upload heap and its named partitions.

nodes.name: Heaps & Resources
nodes.desc: Memory heaps, placement of resources inside them, and committed/placed resource wrappers.

nodes.name: GPU Synchronization
nodes.desc: Fences and events, plus frame-level tracking of which GPU work has actually retired.

nodes.name: Descriptors & Views
nodes.desc: Descriptor heaps, every view type, table builders and bindless allocation management.

nodes.name: Upload & Streaming
nodes.desc: Per-frame and dedicated upload allocators, subresource uploader and constant data stream.

nodes.name: Pipeline State
nodes.desc: Root signature construction, graphics/compute PSOs, D3D blobs and XML-described PSO presets.

nodes.name: Constant Buffers
nodes.desc: Reflection-driven constant buffer layout and typed mapping of CPU data into GPU memory.

nodes.name: Vertex & Index Buffers
nodes.desc: Segmented vertex/index buffer construction and the view bindings the command list consumes.

nodes.name: Command Submission
nodes.desc: Queues, recorded command lists, recycled allocator rings and batched resource barriers.

nodes.name: GPU Queries
nodes.desc: Timestamp, occlusion and statistics query heaps with per-frame resolve into readback memory.

nodes.name: Memory Heaps
nodes.desc: Typed D3D12 heaps with CPU page property and memory pool selection for UMA and NUMA adapters.

nodes.name: Heap Resource Placer
nodes.desc: Walks a heap linearly, honouring per-resource alignment, to hand out placement offsets.

nodes.name: Resources
nodes.desc: Resource descriptors, state tracking and the placed/committed allocation strategies.

nodes.name: Hashable Descriptors
nodes.desc: Hash wrapper that lets identical view descriptions collapse onto one descriptor slot.

nodes.name: Resource View Descriptors
nodes.desc: Per-view descriptions for buffers, textures and texture arrays, plus sampler descriptors.

nodes.name: Descriptor Table Builders
nodes.desc: Accumulate views and emit one contiguous descriptor table for resources, samplers, RTVs and DSVs.

nodes.name: Descriptor Heaps
nodes.desc: Shader-visible and staging heaps sized from global settings, one set per frame in flight.

nodes.name: Allocation Managers
nodes.desc: Sub-allocates heap ranges and reserves bindless SRV slots that shaders index dynamically.

nodes.name: Allocator Ring
nodes.desc: Per-frame command allocator ring that recycles allocators once their frame has retired.

nodes.name: Resource Barriers
nodes.desc: Static and dynamic barrier packs, including split begin/end barriers, applied in one call.

nodes.name: Command Lists
nodes.desc: Recording surface for draws, dispatches, copies, clears and bundle invocation contexts.

nodes.name: Command Queues
nodes.desc: Direct, compute and copy queues with priority, GPU timeout control and timestamp frequency.

nodes.name: D3D Data Blobs
nodes.desc: Wrapper over ID3DBlob used to carry shader bytecode and serialized root signatures.

nodes.name: Root Signatures
nodes.desc: Root entries, descriptor tables, static samplers and shader visibility, compiled to a blob.

nodes.name: PSO XML Parser
nodes.desc: Parses the XML PSO descriptions under scripts/d3d12_PSOs into PSO descriptor structures.

nodes.name: Pipeline States
nodes.desc: Graphics and compute PSO descriptors and the compiled, cache-aware pipeline state object.

nodes.name: Upload Allocators
nodes.desc: Dedicated and per-frame ring allocators carving staging blocks out of the upload heap.

nodes.name: Resource Data Uploader
nodes.desc: Copies placed subresources from staging memory into their destination GPU resources.

nodes.name: Constant Buffer Stream
nodes.desc: Frame-scoped stream that hands out constant buffer allocations to rendering tasks.

nodes.name: Fences
nodes.desc: ID3D12Fence wrapper with sharing modes for cross-queue and cross-adapter signalling.

nodes.name: Signals
nodes.desc: Couples a fence with an OS event so the CPU can block until a target value is reached.

nodes.name: Frame Progress Tracker
nodes.desc: Tracks scheduled versus completed frames to bound frames in flight and drive resource reuse.

nodes.name: Constant Buffer Reflection
nodes.desc: Declares constant buffer members and computes HLSL-conformant offsets and padding.

nodes.name: Constant Data Mapper
nodes.desc: Binds typed CPU data providers to reflected members and writes them into mapped memory.

nodes.name: Constant Buffer
nodes.desc: The GPU-side constant buffer resource the mapped, reflected data is finally committed to.

nodes.name: Vertex & Index Buffers
nodes.desc: Segmented buffer construction over placed resources with per-attribute stride bookkeeping.

nodes.name: Buffer Bindings
nodes.desc: Immutable view sets handed to the command list when binding geometry for a draw.

nodes.name: Image Loader Contract
nodes.desc: Abstract loader exposing mip, layer and format description for a decoded source image.

nodes.name: KTX Loader
nodes.desc: Reads KTX containers, including already block-compressed and cube/array textures.

nodes.name: PNG / JPEG Loader
nodes.desc: Decodes PNG and JPEG sources into linear RGBA surfaces ready for conversion.

nodes.name: Image Loader Pool
nodes.desc: Picks the loader that matches a source and pools loader instances across scene loads.

nodes.name: GPU Texture Converter
nodes.desc: Mip generation and GPU-accelerated block compression, with results kept in the texture cache.

nodes.name: Images & Samplers
nodes.desc: Scene-owned GPU textures and sampler states resolved from glTF texture references.

nodes.name: Scene Mesh Memory
nodes.desc: Single large GPU buffer sub-allocated into vertex, index and instance regions per scene.

nodes.name: Materials
nodes.desc: Metallic-roughness parameters plus the de-duplicated static state that selects a PSO.

nodes.name: Meshes & Submeshes
nodes.desc: Meshes as submesh collections, each with its own attribute layout and material binding.

nodes.name: Lights & Cameras
nodes.desc: Light and camera objects attached to scene nodes, supplying view and projection transforms.

nodes.name: Scene & Nodes
nodes.desc: glTF import, id-based node hierarchy with lazy transforms, and GPU instancing draw queries.

nodes.name: Rendering Work Base
nodes.desc: Schedulable base that owns command lists and reacts to rendering configuration changes.

nodes.name: Submesh Draw Task
nodes.desc: Records instanced draws for a scene's submeshes using its cached PSOs and descriptor tables.

nodes.name: UI Draw Task
nodes.desc: Drives ImGui: feeds OS input, builds UI provider geometry and records its draw commands.

nodes.name: Test Rendering Task
nodes.desc: Reference task that exercises PSO caching, constant streaming and dynamic geometry.

nodes.name: Query Flush Task
nodes.desc: Resolves the frame's timestamp and statistics queries into CPU-readable memory.

nodes.name: GPU Work Execution
nodes.desc: Terminal node that closes the recorded lists and submits them to the matching command queue.

nodes.name: Rendering Target
nodes.desc: Colour and depth attachment set with its RTV/DSV tables and current resource states.

nodes.name: Frame Progress
nodes.desc: Frame index and completion state shared by allocators, descriptor heaps and upload rings.

nodes.name: G-Buffer
nodes.desc: Deferred-shading attachment set allocated against the device and current MSAA mode.

nodes.name: Basic Rendering Services
nodes.desc: Per-frame defaults every task uses: viewport, target binding, constant and geometry streams.

nodes.name: Swap Chain Link
nodes.desc: Owns back-buffer targets and the depth buffer, and rebuilds them on window size change.

nodes.name: Rendering Loop
nodes.desc: Builds the frame task graph, runs it through the task sink and flushes the GPU on teardown.

nodes.name: UI Provider Contract
nodes.desc: Interface each overlay implements so the UI draw task can build its ImGui geometry.

nodes.name: Console Commands
nodes.desc: Command registry with token filtering and autocomplete over registered command names.

nodes.name: Debug Console
nodes.desc: Scrollback console with keyboard capture, log mirroring and inline command execution.

nodes.name: Profiler Overlay
nodes.desc: Live CPU and GPU timing view built from the profiling services attached to each task.

nodes.name: D3D12 Initializer
nodes.desc: Brings up logging, settings, caches and the device; creates swap chains and the render loop.

nodes.name: Public Initializer
nodes.desc: API-agnostic front door: takes EngineSettings, picks an adapter and returns a window handler.

nodes.name: Demo Application
nodes.desc: Sample host that opens a window, drives the render loop and exercises the public API.

nodes.name: Test Harness
nodes.desc: Unit tests over task graphs, streamed caches, PSO XML parsing and image conversion.
